features.name: Basic metronome start and stop
steps: Tap the play button at the bottom
Observe the top beat dots and the sound
features.expected: After starting it must sound periodically at the current BPM; the top beat visualization changes in sync; after stopping the sound stops immediately and the current beat state is reset/frozen; duplicate timers causing acceleration must not occur

features.name: Adjust the BPM slider
steps: Drag the "beats per minute" slider to another value
features.expected: The BPM number and the slider position sync in both directions; after changing the BPM the audio interval must change accordingly; e.g. 120 BPM implies a main beat period of about 0.5 seconds; updating only the number without updating the timer is not allowed

features.name: Direct BPM input
steps: Tap the BPM number box on the right
features.expected: The text box, slider, and actual playback speed must agree; the keyboard closes correctly after input completes; re-entering the input box shows the current value

features.name: BPM increment/decrement fine tuning
steps: Verify that the BPM increases gradually
features.expected: Each tap changes by a fixed step; the number, slider, and actual speed update in sync; the bounds must not be exceeded near the limits

features.name: Tap Tempo tapping speed measurement
steps: Tap the drum-shaped Tap Tempo button in the middle
Tap repeatedly at a steady tempo
Tap again at a faster/slower tempo
features.expected: Derive the BPM from the intervals between adjacent or recent taps; after several taps the value should approach the human tempo; after a long pause the Tap sequence should be re-established; the public feature description explicitly includes Tap Tempo. F-Droid

features.name: Adjust the beats per bar
steps: Change "beats" from the default 4 to another value
Observe the change in the number of top dots
features.expected: The number of top dots should change with the beat count; each bar strictly cycles 1 → 2 → … → N → 1; the first beat must be clearly distinguished from the subsequent beats; extra or missed beats must not occur during modification

features.name: Direct beat-count input
steps: Tap the number box to the right of "beats"
View the slider and the top dots
features.expected: The input, slider, and visualized beat count sync; illegal/out-of-range values must be limited or rejected; the number box in the screenshot is an editable input rather than a static label

features.name: Adjust the bar/subdivision parameters
steps: Set parameters different from the defaults
Compare the rhythm structure with the default value
features.expected: This parameter must genuinely affect the beat structure rather than only displaying a value; the public feature description confirms that the app supports adjustable subdivisions, so the reproduction must cover different subdivision states. GitHub

features.name: Beat and subdivision combination
steps: Set several "beats + bars/subdivisions" combinations, e.g. low beats + low subdivisions and high beats + many subdivisions
Run several complete loops for each group
features.expected: There is a combined state of the two parameters; the main beats, bar boundaries, subdivision sounds, and the top visualization must not drift after long runs; after switching the combination the old scheduler must be cleaned up correctly

features.name: First-beat accent
steps: Then close this option to compare
features.expected: The first beat of each bar must have a clearly different sound/accent rather than being accented only on the first playback; the first beat must be re-accented in every new bar

features.name: Beat visual loop
steps: Change to another beat count and play again
features.expected: The current beat's dot state moves beat by beat; the screenshot shows that dots are distinguished as filled/hollow while playing; the sound and visuals must not be off by one beat; the state is reasonably restored after stopping

features.name: Audio and visuals strictly synchronized
steps: Observe the dot switching and listen to the ticks at the same time
Run continuously for a longer time
features.expected: Each visual beat should correspond to one actual sound event; no noticeable cumulative drift over runtime; the screen refresh and audio scheduling should be decoupled but share the same clock logic

features.name: Change the BPM in real time during playback
steps: Modify to 96 or another value directly without stopping playback
features.expected: The new BPM should take over smoothly at the next beat/reasonable moment; running two BPMs at once, repeated ticks within a short time, long pauses, or a misplaced beat order must not occur

features.name: Change the beat count during playback
steps: Change the beat count to another value
Observe the top dots and the next bar
features.expected: The UI must immediately adapt to the new beat count; how the current loop transitions must stay consistent; the dot index must not go out of range and the sound must not keep looping at the old beat count

features.name: Change the subdivision during playback
features.expected: Audio scheduling should switch to the new structure immediately or from a reasonable boundary; the main BPM must not be wrongly changed

features.name: Switch between the four timbres
steps: Choose "intense beep / soft beep / synthesized drum / plucked string" respectively
Return to the home page after selecting each and play a few beats
features.expected: All four options must have audibly different timbres; the selected state persists; the playback tempo must not change because of loading timbre resources

features.name: Switch the timbre during playback
steps: Enter the settings and switch the timbre
features.expected: The new timbre starts at the next beat or a reasonable boundary; the old timbre must not be layered on; switching must not reset other parameters such as the BPM and beat count

features.name: Gap Ticks / intermittent beats
steps: Configure the parameters corresponding to Gap Ticks
Observe the alternation between the normal audible phase and the scheduled mute phase
features.expected: This is a core feature publicly listed for the current version and not an extra extension. The key is that timing continues during the mute phase and the beat phase must be accurate after the sound resumes; the internal clock must not pause because of muting. F-Droid

features.name: BPM music-tempo text
steps: Switch between lower, medium, and higher BPM values
Observe the tempo term such as Andante to the left of/beside the BPM
Then change the BPM by direct input
features.expected: When the BPM range changes the music-tempo description should update in sync; within the same range the term stays unchanged; this is derived UI state for the BPM

features.name: Parameter boundaries and invalid input
steps: Tap the beat and the bar/BPM number fields respectively
Try empty values, 0, overly large numbers, etc.
features.expected: Meaningless running states such as 0 beats or a negative BPM must not be produced; they should be limited, rolled back, or corrected; abnormal input must not crash or let the timer run wild

features.name: Parameter-state persistence
steps: Set a non-default BPM, beat count, bars/subdivisions, timbre, and first-beat accent
features.expected: After restarting the user configuration should be restored according to the target version's actual behavior; the fields must not override one another; the slider, number box, and setting display stay consistent

features.name: System-theme following
steps: Switch the Android system from light to dark
features.expected: It should follow the system theme switch; text, background, controls, and the status bar keep sufficient contrast

features.name: Light/dark theme
steps: Switch the theme to light and dark respectively
Check the home page and the settings page
features.expected: The app's public description includes Light/Dark Theme; changing the theme must not reset the beat parameters or playback configuration. GitHub

features.name: Beat continuity in the foreground and background
steps: Switch to another app / return to the desktop
Wait for a period of time
features.expected: The current version declares media-playback foreground-service capabilities, so it can serve as a higher-difficulty state task; the beats must not drift noticeably in the background or be started multiple times, and after returning the visuals should resync with the current beat. IzzySoft Apt Repositories

features.name: Run stably for a long time
steps: Select a non-default BPM and multi-beat configuration
features.expected: Test the timer precision, audio scheduling, resource release, and cumulative drift; this is the task that best distinguishes a "UI imitation" from a genuine functional implementation of the metronome
